headline: Oben Electric Becomes India's No. 1 Electric Motorcycle Company, Sells 1,417 Bikes in September, Leaves Others Behind
summary: Oben Electric sold 1,417 electric motorcycles in September 2026, according to Vahan data, making it India's top-selling electric motorcycle brand. The Rorr Evo led sales.
why: Oben Electric is an Indian electric two-wheeler maker, part of the fast-growing electric vehicle market in India. Monthly registration data is a key gauge of demand for the segment.
